title: Unified Contrastive Learning in Image-Text-Label Space
layout_note: Four panels (a)-(d) in a row, each the same structure: two encoders at the bottom, their feature matrices, a product, and a target matrix on top with the label arrow; the paper's own method is (a).
grouping: Panels separated by whitespace with captions (a)-(d) underneath; encoders green (visual) and blue (text / embedding).
shapes_depth: Flat rounded boxes; target matrices as small grids with the positive cells tinted.
proposed_highlight: The paper's method is the first panel, captioned '(Ours)'; the others are the baselines drawn the same way.
lesson: Compare objectives by drawing each as the same two-tower-plus-target-matrix panel, so only the positive pattern differs.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year; remembered venue CVPR 2022 (not verified in this session). Card written while studying arrangement (2026-11-15).

arrangement.units: four panels of identical structure separated by whitespace, each captioned below
arrangement.inputs_as: the words Images / Language under each encoder
arrangement.losses_at: the target matrix with its positives on top of each panel

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
